notes: Own solve: v = v_P + 2v_Q and v_Q − v_P = v/3 give v_P = v/9 and v_Q = 4v/9, so v_Q/v_P = 4. Every printed line follows from the one above it. One convention point, not filed as a finding: for a perfectly elastic collision here v_P = −v/3 and v_Q = 2v/3, so the signed quotient is −2, not +2; common_mistakes[1] states 2. The exam itself prints option 3 as "v_Q/v_P = 2", so the solution is using the paper's own unsigned convention.
